title.zh: Aave V4 proposal would put DAO funds first in line to absorb lending losses
title.en: Aave V4 proposal would put DAO funds first in line to absorb lending losses

current_state.zh: Aave V4 proposal from TokenLogic would have the DAO absorb bad-debt losses first, followed by volunteer underwriters, for WETH, USDC, and USDT Core Hub markets on Ethereum.
current_state.en: Aave V4 proposal from TokenLogic would have the DAO absorb bad-debt losses first, followed by volunteer underwriters, for WETH, USDC, and USDT Core Hub markets on Ethereum.
